newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Tucson Electric estimates up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Tucson Electric estimates up.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it raised its estimate for Tucson Electric Power Co earnings in 1997 to $2.01 from $1.80 and its 1998 estimate to $2.23 from $1.95.
-- The revisions reflect higher taxes, but higher revenue and lower inerest and maintenance expense, EVEREN said.
-- Tucson Electric has experienced strong cash flow, and with the help of a financial restructuring should be able to begin paying dividends in 1999 or 2000, EVEREN said.
-- Once that happens, EVEREN said it believes the utility company's stock price will have more than doubled from its current level.
-- Tucson Electric shares were unchanged Friday at 14-2/16.
